title: Q2 All‑Hands Runbook and Company OKR Draft v0.3
content:
Version history: v0.1 (2026-02-15) initial outline; v0.2 (2026-02-25) added OKR bullets; v0.3 (2026-03-12) updated metrics and logistics notes.

Purpose
- Single working doc for the Q2 company all‑hands: draft company OKRs, exec update talking points, slide ownership, logistics, and immediate follow ups.
- Audience: execs + cross‑functional leads + comms. This is a working draft — please annotate directly in the doc and ping me in #all-hands-planning.

High-level scheduling
- All‑hands target date: 2026-04-08 (Thursday) 10:00–11:15 PT (tentative)
- Dry run w/ execs: 2026-04-01 09:00 PT
- Slides due (first pass): 2026-03-26; final slides: 2026-04-03
- Pre-reads to go out: 2026-04-05 morning

Company OKR draft (top level) — feedback requested by 2026-03-19
Objective A: Make inference predictable and 3x more cost‑efficient for typical prod workloads by EOY.
- KR A1: Reduce average per‑token cost (hosted) by 15% vs. baseline (2025‑Q4) through batching + cache + quantization playbook. (owner: Performance org)
- KR A2: Achieve 99.95% p95 latency SLO for top 3 hosted models under normal load. (owner: Serving runtime)
- KR A3: Ship two quantified quantization profiles for customer‑facing models with <2% quality delta. (owner: Applied ML)

Objective B: Drive adoption of Dedicated and Private for enterprise customers with demonstrable SLA wins.
- KR B1: Close 6 Dedicated deals with committed minimum 3‑month reserved capacity each. (owner: Sales / Dedicated)
- KR B2: Pilot Private deployment (VPC) with 3 customers and onboard SOC & KMS integrations for each. (owner: Private deployments)
- KR B3: Produce an enterprise SLA playbook and win 10 enterprise customers who require it. (owner: GTM/Legal)

Objective C: Improve developer experience & observability to reduce support escalations.
- KR C1: Reduce P50 time to resolution for production incidents by 30% (baseline = 2025 avg). (owner: SRE/Support)
- KR C2: Launch per‑route cost + latency dashboard for >80% of key customers. (owner: Console)
- KR C3: Ship SDK 3.0 with streaming & function calls stabilized across languages. (owner: DevX)

Notes on OKRs
- These are draft targets — numbers are intentionally aggressive but within sight. Please push back with concrete alternate suggestions.
- We should align compensation/bonus pools to Objective A + B where possible. Execs: confirm by 2026‑03‑19.

Exec update / talking points (15 minutes)
- Opening: State the why (market + platform thesis) and call out Q1 momentum (usage growth, latency wins, 2 new Dedicated deals).
- Metrics to highlight (1 slide): M/M token volume, revenue (hosted + committed), p95 latency for top two models, new enterprise leads.
- Risk slate (1 slide): supply constraints (GPU procurement), SRE burn rate, Private onboarding delays. State mitigations.
- Ask of the company (1 slide): 3 focus areas for Q2 (performance economics, Dedicated sales, console observability).

All‑hands agenda (75 min total)
- 10m — Welcome + company state (CEO)
- 10m — Exec update + metrics (CTO or Ops lead)
- 20m — Product roadmap highlights (Product leads): Hosted API, Dedicated, Private, Optimize features
- 15m — Customer story (Solutions Eng + CSM) — short demo + impact metrics
- 10m — People + org updates (People Ops)
- 10m — AMA / live Q&A (moderated)

Slide ownership (first pass owners, update if different)
- CEO: opening + asks (Asha Patel)
- Ops/CTO: exec metrics + risk (Diego Martinez)
- Product hosted & dedicated: roadmap (Lina Chen, Priya Nair)
- Private deployment update: Evan Brooks
- Customer story slide: Solutions Eng (Samir Gupta)
- People & hiring: People Ops (Maya Holt)

Pre‑read package (to include)
- One‑pager: Q2 focus + OKR summary (1 page)
- 3 metric charts (token volume, p95 latency, hosted revenue trend)
- 2 customer vignettes (Dedicated + Private pilot)
- Note: aim for <6 pages total.

Logistics & runbook (AV, accessibility, comms)
- Venue: hybrid; main campus auditorium + Zoom. AV checklist: laptop, projector, livestream mic, captions. (Tech lead: Facilities)
- Closed captions: request Live Captions via Zoom; test during dry run.
- Recording: auto‑record and upload to shared drive + short highlights clip.
- Slack: create thread #all-hands-2026-04-08 for live questions; designate two moderators to aggregate.
- Polls: 1 company pulse poll during the meeting (People Ops to produce question).

Dry run plan (2026‑04‑01)
- Full deck run with execs + slide owners. Time each section. Ensure transitions and video demos are <90s.
- AV test w/ live captioning.
- Backup plan: if live demo fails, have pre-recorded 60s clip available (owner: Product).

AMA / Q&A format
- Moderators collect questions via Slack thread + live Zoom Q&A. Prioritize strategic & cross‑company concerns.
- Reserve 10 questions in queue; 3 reserved for People Ops (comp/hires) + 2 for Product roadmap deep dives.

Comms & post‑all‑hands follow up
- Publish recording + 1‑pager + slides same day. (Comms owner: Lina Chen)
- Capture 5 follow‑ups with owners and due dates. Consolidate into single action tracker (sheet).

Open questions / unresolved items
- OKR owners: confirm measurability and metric owners (who owns p95 latency telemetry?) — assigned to Diego.
- Compensation linkage to OKRs — need legal + finance input (Finance: TBD).
- Dedicated revenue forecast — Sales to provide minimum ARR estimates by 2026‑03‑19.
- Headcount ask: engineering hiring request for +6 backend GPUs infra engineers — People Ops needs justification doc.

Immediate action items (next 2 weeks)
- All slide owners: upload first pass (3–5 slides) to share by 2026‑03‑26. (owner: slide owners)
- Product: finalize OKR KR definitions and measurement plans by 2026‑03‑19. (owner: Lina)
- Comms: draft pre‑read one‑pager by 2026‑03‑29. (owner: Lina)
- SRE: confirm p95 telemetry and dashboard access for exec review by 2026‑03‑20. (owner: Evan)
- Org‑ops: reserve auditorium + Zoom license for date; request AV support. (owner: Asha)

Notes to reviewers (how to comment)
- Inline comments: add a short note in this doc and prefix with initials.
- Urgent changes: ping @asha in Slack.
- If you disagree with any KR number, propose a revised metric and a short rationale (2–3 lines).

Appendix: suggested metric baselines (working numbers)
- Hosted avg per‑token cost baseline (2025‑Q4): $0.00045/token — target Q4 reduction = 15%
- p95 latency baseline for model-A: 420ms — target <400ms p95
- Hosted revenue baseline (TTM): $18.2M — target +25% YoY for next quarter (stretch)

Rough timeline for iteration
- 2026‑03‑19: OKR owners sign off on metrics
- 2026‑03‑26: Slides first pass due
- 2026‑04‑01: Dry run
- 2026‑04‑03: Final slides due
- 2026‑04‑05: Pre‑reads distributed
- 2026‑04‑08: All‑hands event

Quick links (placeholders — update if you have canonical links)
- Roadmap confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Q2-Roadmap-Draft
- Action tracker (sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder
- Event calendar invite: created by Asha (will attach once date locked)

End — please comment inline.

(Notes to self: follow up with Diego on telemetry owner; loop in Finance + Legal for Dedicated contract language.)
